## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:合后审计 `check-governed-merges.mjs` 的 skills arm 一腿收紧 PR #33711 评审留下的六处 nit:arm 需要的 git 读取失败或 fork 判定没测到时记 NOT MEASURED(不再折成 Tier H);合并后才被撤销的授权批准按合并时的状态读;"合并后被编辑"一句挂在每种 BREACH 理由上,且只点名本该被读成记录的那条;没有受信作者名单记 NOT MEASURED,被作者绑定丢掉的评论按守卫原话计数。校验器 `verify-review-tier.mjs` 另拒 `Skill` 和向别的线程、会话、触发器发消息或启动它们的连接器工具。N6 以理由关闭,不改代码。
- 为什么改:卡 #33729 是 #33711 三份复核记录(6890932729、6891274033、6891542450)的 nit 清单,按 #33718 裁决 B 一卡一 PR。
- 风险与回滚:只动两个 `scripts/pm/` 工具文件,不发布。方向全部是收紧:Tier H 可能变 NOT MEASURED(整轮 INCOMPLETE,退出 2);唯一由 BREACH 变 cleared 的是 N8 点名的情形(合并后撤销的授权批准),这是该项本身要的。校验器多拒一类转录。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` 的 `readArmLanding`、`armReadsNotMeasured`、`reviewsAsLanded`;`scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs` 的 `SUB_AGENT_TOOL_SHAPES`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs --self-test`,预期两行成功判定(741 条断言;30 个用例)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Card #33729's checklist, item by item. Every reading still goes through the queue guard's exports (`ARM_READER_EXPORTS`, now with `ignoredAuthorLines`); no second parser.

| Item | Verdict | Where |
|:--|:--|:--|
| N3 `SUB_AGENT_TOOLS` is an exact-name list | Fixed. `handsWorkToAnotherAgent` adds `SUB_AGENT_TOOL_SHAPES`: `Skill` (a skill can fork into a sub-agent and reads the same in the file either way), and a connector tool `mcp__SERVER__TOOL` whose tool name starts with `send`, `message`, `start`, `fire`, `spawn`, `dispatch` or `delegate`, or names a trigger. The `mcp__SERVER__TOOL` spelling was measured in a session transcript (`mcp__hearthbot__message_thread`). Fail closed: a read-only connector tool that fits the shape refuses too. | `verify-review-tier.mjs`, 3 pin rows |
| N5 a git-side read failing in the arm folds into `tier-h` | Fixed. `readArmLanding` hands the arm a git reader that records every throw; when the arm reads H with a recorded throw, or with the fork predicate not measured, the landing is `not-measured` with the failed read and the arm's reasons (`armReadsNotMeasured`). One exception, read rather than assumed: `git show SHA:PATH` throws for a changeset the commit deleted, and the arm reads that H by itself; an empty `git ls-tree` of that path at that commit proves the deletion, so it stays a measured Tier H. The Tier H cell now says how many reasons it did not print (`(+N more)`). | `check-governed-merges.mjs`, 5 pin rows |
| N6 `baseRef` is the first parent, not the merge group's base | Closed with a reason, no code change. `baseRef` is read only by the carry test (`regenCarry` in `record-recognisers.mjs`), through `git merge-base BASE HEAD`. Between the merge group's base and the landed commit's first parent lie only the squash commits of entries ahead in the same group. A head that contains one of those was pushed after that entry landed, which takes it out of the queue, so its next group's base already holds it. Either way `git merge-base` of the two bases with a queued head names the same commit, and the carry reads the same. The reasoning is in `readArmLanding`'s jsdoc. | jsdoc |
| N8 an approval dismissed after the landing no longer clears | Fixed. `reviewsAsLanded` puts a review that now reads DISMISSED back in the state the timeline's `review_dismissed` event names (`dismissed_review.state`, matched by `dismissed_review.review_id`) when that event is dated at or after the landing. A dismissal before the landing, with no event, or of a non-approval clears nothing. The event's shape is GitHub's documented timeline shape; no live dismissal was found to measure it on, and a shape that does not match leaves the review DISMISSED (toward BREACH, as today). | `check-governed-merges.mjs`, 2 pin rows |
| N9 the edited-after clause rides only `absent` | Fixed. It is appended to every BREACH reason (`absent`, `below-tier`, `unsigned`, `not-pass`). | 1 pin row |
| N10 the clause names any trusted comment edited after the landing; "A, B was edited" | Fixed with the guard's own reader, no new recogniser: the record leg runs once more, read-only, on the threads with the edited rows put back (`guard.recordVerdict` on `unedited`), and the clause names the edited row only when that run would have read it as the record. So a claim or report edited after the merge is never named, and the clause names one comment. | 2 pin rows |
| N11 no row for unavailable recognisers or a set without `trustedAuthors`; an untrusted PASS reads like no record | Fixed. A recogniser set with no trusted-author list (null or empty) is now `not-measured` before any thread is read, where it read BREACH (every row dropped); both readings fail closed, and a missing reading is NOT MEASURED. The comments the author binding dropped (those existing at the landing) are counted on `pass` and `breach` rows in the guard's own words (`ignoredAuthorLines`). | 3 pin rows |

Direction check against the order ("nothing here may make the audit read `pass` where it reads BREACH or NOT MEASURED today unless the item says so"): no state moves to `pass`. N5 and N11 move `tier-h` and `breach` to `not-measured`. N8 moves a `breach` to `cleared` only for an authorized approval dismissed after the landing, which is what N8 asks.

## Acceptance notes

- N8's restore reads only GitHub-written timeline events, and only to restore a state the queue saw; it never invents an approval.
- N3 widens what the verifier refuses, so an honest review run that calls `Skill` now refuses; the remedy is the existing one (review in an agent that calls no other).
- Carried elsewhere, unchanged: raw relay comment tier #33715, `contract-review.md` session evidence #33716, weekly audit owner #33717.
